name: open-computer-use
description: Open-source Computer Use with a shared Runtime, Host Adapters, Model Profiles, and sparse Bindings.

interface.shortDescription: Control desktop apps from Codex with the open local server
interface.longDescription: Open Computer Use V1.1 packages the macOS ten-tool Runtime with a Codex Adapter and GPT Model Profile. Experimental Linux and Windows runtimes retain the nine-tool subset without select_text.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the current UI state of this desktop app without stealing focus when possible
Open a new local document with keyboard shortcuts first, then type content without moving my real pointer unless required
Drive the fixture app and verify the ten macOS computer-use tools still behave correctly
